## What changed and why?

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their results, and any relevant limitations.

## AI assistance and third-party sources

Describe any substantial AI-generated or AI-rewritten material, the affected
parts, and how you reviewed and validated it.

Identify known copied or adapted material, its source, its license, and any
required notices. State any unresolved permission or licensing questions. Write
"None" where applicable, and explain any relevant uncertainty. Do not include
confidential information.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I reviewed and understand this contribution, including any AI-assisted material.
- [ ] I have the right to submit it under the applicable license and have preserved required third-party notices.
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and the DCO; every commit author and declared co-author has supplied their own matching sign-off.
- [ ] I updated relevant tests and documentation, or explained why none are needed.
- [ ] I recorded user-visible changes in the changelog or the project's release-note process, when applicable.
- [ ] I removed credentials and private information from the change and this description.
